problem_statement: The UUID library needs a way to determine whether a given UUID is the Nil/empty UUID — the special form defined in RFC9562 where all 128 bits are zero. The check must return true when given an all-zero UUID and when given a UUID parsed from the canonical string "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", and must return false for a UUID that has any non-zero byte (for example the UUID parsed from "44b35f73-cfbd-43b4-8fef-ca7baea1375f").
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/lib/uuid -s tests/lib/uuid/libraries.uuid.base -s libraries.uuid.base -O twister-out --no-clean -W
